{'translation': 'This week, Apple continues to steadily expand its Apple Sports app, broadening football coverage while offering tennis fans new ways to follow select major tournaments. Here are the latest updates.', 'translation_zh': '本週，Apple 持續穩步擴展旗下 Apple Sports 應用程式，既擴大足球賽事覆蓋範圍，同時為網球迷提供追蹤部分重要錦標賽的新方式。以下是最新更新內容。'}

{'translation': 'Apple Sports Adds New Football Leagues and Tennis Draws', 'translation_zh': 'Apple Sports 新增足球聯賽及網球對戰表'}

{'translation': 'When Apple first launched the Apple Sports app, the experience was quite limited in terms of both availability and the sports it covered.', 'translation_zh': 'Apple 首次推出 Apple Sports 應用程式時，無論在可用地區還是涵蓋的運動項目上，體驗都相當有限。'}

{'translation': 'Since then, the app has grown significantly on both fronts, now available in over 170 countries and regions, with continued support for new sports, leagues, and tournaments.', 'translation_zh': '自此之後，該應用程式在兩方面均有長足發展，已覆蓋超過 170 個國家及地區，並持續加入對新運動項目、聯賽及錦標賽的支援。'}

{'translation': 'For example, earlier this year Apple Sports expanded to 90 new countries and rolled out several new features around the FIFA World Cup.', 'translation_zh': '舉例而言，今年較早時 Apple Sports 拓展至 90 個新國家，並圍繞 FIFA 世界盃推出多項新功能。'}

{'translation': 'This week, Apple Sports updated again, adding the Australian A-League Men, the Egyptian Premier League, the Israeli Premier League, and the South African Premiership to its football lineup.', 'translation_zh': '本週 Apple Sports 再度更新，於足球賽事陣容中加入澳洲 A 級男足聯賽（Australian A-League Men）、埃及超級聯賽（Egyptian Premier League）、以色列超級聯賽（Israeli Premier League）及南非超級聯賽（South African Premiership）。'}

{'translation': 'In addition, Apple says the app now lets tennis fans "follow live draws and view brackets for Grand Slams and 1000-level tournaments," noting that users can "see matchups and results for every round at a glance."', 'translation_zh': '此外，Apple 表示，該應用程式現讓網球迷能夠「實時追蹤賽事抽籤結果，以及大滿貫及 1000 級賽事的對戰表」，並指用戶可以「一目了然地查看每輪的對陣及賽果」。'}

{'translation': 'Here are the full release notes for Apple Sports version 4.4:', 'translation_zh': '以下是 Apple Sports 4.4 版的完整更新說明：'}

{'translation': "The football lineup keeps growing with the addition of the Australian A-League Men, the Egyptian Premier League, the Israeli Premier League, and the South African Premiership. Tennis fans can now follow live draws in Apple Sports and view brackets for Grand Slams and 1000-level tournaments, making it easy to keep track of every round's matchups and results.", 'translation_zh': '足球賽事陣容持續擴大，新增澳洲 A 級男足聯賽、埃及超級聯賽、以色列超級聯賽及南非超級聯賽。網球迷現可於 Apple Sports 實時追蹤賽事抽籤結果，並查看大滿貫及 1000 級賽事的對戰表，輕鬆掌握每輪的對陣及賽果。'}

{'translation': 'Do you use Apple Sports? Let us know in the comments.', 'translation_zh': '你有使用 Apple Sports 嗎？歡迎在留言區告訴我們。'}
